title: Look inside a property
description: From your property list to a property's units (two pages).

steps.title: Properties
steps.text: Every property you manage, with its unit count and occupancy.

steps.title: Filter by type
steps.text: Narrow the list to multi-family, condos, or duplexes.

steps.text: Units, how many are occupied, and the rent they bring in each month.
